title: The share extension needs its own privacy manifest
acceptance: CairnShareExtension carries a PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declaring the UserDefaults required-reason API it actually calls
The reason code is the app-group one, matching the app's existing manifest
Collected data types are declared as none, matching Data Not Collected
The manifest is bundled into the extension by the build, not merely present on disk
notes: Surfaced reviewing T-0010. project.yml compiles Stacks/Services/AppGroup.swift into StacksShareExtension too, so the extension binary also calls UserDefaults — but T-0010's manifest lands only in the app bundle. Apple's guidance on per-extension manifests is ambiguous enough that this is a judgement call, not an implementation task. Kept out of T-0010 rather than widening its scope.
